description: Review service dependencies and wave ordering

questions.question: Are wave assignments correct based on dependencies?
questions.notes: Services with no dependencies must build first. Dependent services must wait.

questions.question: Are there any circular dependencies between services?
questions.notes: Circular deps must be resolved before building (merge or restructure)

questions.question: Is the state backend configuration correct?
questions.notes: S3 bucket name and DynamoDB lock table follow naming patterns

questions.question: Are all service dependencies explicitly documented?
questions.notes: Each service should list what it depends on (networking, IAM, databases)

questions.question: Are there missing services that should be added?
questions.notes: VPC, IAM roles, KMS keys, monitoring, etc.

questions.question: Should any services be combined into a single wave?
questions.notes: Services with mutual dependencies or very tight coupling
